Qnity is hiring a Manufacturing Software Developer to support and develop its GUPI Manufacturing Execution System (MES) platform and related applications. The role investigates application, data, and integration issues, implements enhancements, and works with manufacturing, quality, engineering, and IT teams to support operational requirements.

Responsibilities
Provide first-line support for the GUPI MES platform and related applications
Maintain and improve existing application code
Investigate software defects, data issues, and system integration problems
Develop, test, and deploy assigned application enhancements
Analyze requirements and support application testing, quality assurance, configuration, and implementation
Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, engineering, and IT teams to understand operational requirements
Contribute to process improvement projects, technical documentation, and knowledge sharing
Follow established development practices and prescribed guidelines when resolving standard problems
Build technical capabilities and gradually assume greater ownership of assigned applications
